notes:
Lead: Snowglen runs a multinational CCaaS platform (50k MAUs, 8 regional contact centers). CEO priority: reduce average handle time (AHT) and improve first-contact resolution using AI-driven agent assist and automated summarization.

Discovery highlights / needs (shorthand):
- Primary workload: live agent assist (real-time suggestions), post-call ticket summarization, automated tool-calls into back-end CRM (create/update cases, run triage workflows).
- RAG requirements: multi-source retrieval across product KB, support tickets, release notes, and third-party vendor docs. Must present citations + source freshness per snippet.
- Latency SLO: interactive suggestions P50 < 120ms, P95 < 350ms end-to-end (agent UI -> model -> suggestion). Ticket summarization can be async (batch within 5s).
- Throughput / spikes: baseline 600 concurrent agents, peak spikes up to 3x during product incidents (target design for 2000 concurrent inference streams). Need graceful degradation (degraded context size, fallback smaller model) not hard failures.
- Consistency & explainability: prefer RAG that returns attribution spans with linkable anchors; confidence score + origination date. Freshness TTL options: nearline embedding refresh (daily) + changelog triggers for critical KB updates.
- Retrieval stack preferences: vector DB (open to Weaviate/Pinecone) + hybrid BM25 filter; want Redwood Optimize recommendations for chunk size, embedding model, and quantization tradeoffs.
- Security/compliance: EU data residency mandatory for embeddings + logs. SSO via SAML, SCIM for user provisioning, audit logs retention 7 years for regulated clients. KMS integration + option for customer-managed keys required.
- Model preferences: open-source foundation models allowed (fine-tuned instruct variants). Want ability to route sensitive traffic to private on-prem LLMs. Fallback chain between hosted/open, dedicated quantized, and private hosted in VPC.
- Tool-calling: require secure service account tokens with short TTL, tracing of external tool invocations, idempotency guarantees for CRM writes.
- Evaluation metrics requested: citation accuracy, hallucination rate (qualitative), latency P50/P95, tokens per session, cost per 1k sessions, FCR lift and AHT reduction measured vs baseline.
